sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What do we call a group of people living in the same area and sharing common facilities?
Which insect is known for living together in a highly organized colony, similar to human communities?
Where should you go in your neighbourhood to safely deposit your savings?

options: A) A highway for fast cars
B) A designated path through a natural environment for walking and observing
C) A track for racing bicycles
questions.answer: B) A designated path through a natural environment for walking and observing

questions.question_text: Which type of nutrient is primarily found in rice and wheat, giving us energy to play?
Which of these is a natural resource essential for all living beings to grow?
Why should we wash raw fruits and vegetables before eating them?
options: C) To remove dirt and harmful germs
D) To make them grow bigger
questions.answer: C) To remove dirt and harmful germs

questions.question_text: Who keeps our neighbourhood streets clean and hygienic?
Planting more trees in our surroundings helps to make the air...
Which of the following items is considered a 'body-building' food rich in proteins?
Why is it important to have good relations with our neighbours? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Good neighbours help us during emergencies, celebrate festivals together, and make our community a much safer and happier place to live.

questions.question_text: Mention two important public services found in a neighbourhood and their main uses. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A hospital provides medical care when we are sick, and a police station helps maintain law and order to keep citizens safe.

questions.question_text: Name three things you might observe closely while walking on a nature trail. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: On a nature trail, you might closely observe different types of wild plants, colorful insects, chirping birds, and the rough textures of tree bark.

questions.question_text: How can children actively help in protecting the nature around their homes? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Children can protect nature by not wasting tap water, planting green saplings in their gardens, and throwing garbage only in proper dustbins.

questions.question_text: Why is eating a balanced diet highly important for a growing child? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A balanced diet provides all necessary nutrients like vitamins, proteins, and carbohydrates in the right amounts to keep a growing child healthy and strong.

questions.question_text: Imagine a new family has just moved into your neighbourhood. Describe how you would welcome them and introduce them to the local area. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would smile, introduce myself, and offer them some home-cooked sweets. I would tell them where the nearest grocery store, park, and hospital are located, and invite their children to play with me in the evening so they feel welcome.

questions.question_text: Imagine you have adopted a small potted plant. Describe the daily steps you will take to make sure it grows healthy and strong. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I will keep the plant near a bright window so it gets plenty of morning sunlight. I will water it gently every day, making sure the soil is moist but not muddy. I will also regularly remove any dry, yellow leaves.

questions.question_text: Create a healthy daily meal plan for a Class 4 student. Explain why you chose these specific foods for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: For breakfast, I choose milk and oats to provide morning energy. Lunch includes dal, roti, and green vegetables to give proteins and vitamins for physical growth. Dinner should be light, like vegetable soup and rice, to help with easy digestion before sleeping. This ensures balanced nutrition throughout the entire day.

questions.question_text: Explain how teamwork and community bonding are shown during a festival celebration in a neighbourhood. Give specific examples. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: During community festivals, teamwork is visible when everyone works together. Neighbours join hands to decorate the streets with beautiful lights or colourful flags. They share special traditional food, help clean the community areas, and organize fun cultural programs together. This shared effort brings immense joy and strengthens the bond among residents.
